answer: In an autonomous AI economy, cryptographic stake-weighting prevents Sybil attacks by enforcing a scarce resource barrier. Validators must lock native tokens, like a cryptographic plume of verifiable collateral, inside a secure smart contract resembling an immutable onyx vault. Generating a fake identity demands procuring real computational hardware and wiring physical copper connections, making the marginal cost of creating additional nodes economically prohibitive for malicious actors.
